FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'Pleased to meet you'? (1 mark)
   A. Enchanté
   B. Enchante
   C. Enchantè
   D. Enchnté

2. How do you say 'Mrs, Madam' in French? (1 mark)
   A. merci
   B. non
   C. Monsieur
   D. Madame

3. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'grandmother'? (1 mark)
   A. grand-mère
   B. grand-mere
   C. grand-mére
   D. gran-mère

4. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'grandfather'? (1 mark)
   A. gran-père
   B. grand-pére
   C. grand-pere
   D. grand-père

5. How do you say 'the bag' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la salle de bain
   B. le sac
   C. la douche
   D. la cuisine

6. How do you say 'the bed' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le salon
   B. le lit
   C. le sac
   D. la salle de bain

7. Which sentence has the correct word order? (1 mark)
   A. Sous la chaise le est sac.
   B. Le sac sous est la chaise.
   C. Est le sac sous la chaise.
   D. Le sac est sous la chaise.

8. How do you say 'Wednesday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. lundi
   B. mercredi
   C. mardi
   D. vendredi

9. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'school'? (1 mark)
   A. école
   B. ècole
   C. écoe
   D. ecole

10. How do you say 'a party' in French? (1 mark)
   A. un gâteau
   B. un cadeau
   C. un ballon
   D. une fête

11. How do you say the month 'July' in French? (1 mark)
   A. avril
   B. novembre
   C. février
   D. juillet

12. How do you say 'the cake' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le gâteau
   B. la mangue
   C. le pain
   D. les fruits

13. How do you say 'rice' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la santé
   B. le riz
   C. les fruits
   D. l'eau

14. How do you say 'the orange' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'orange
   B. la carotte
   C. le pain
   D. le gâteau

15. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'head'? (1 mark)
   A. tête
   B. têe
   C. te´te
   D. tete

16. How do you say 'the ear' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pied
   B. le nez
   C. la dent
   D. l'oreille

17. How do you say 'a flood' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la neige
   B. une inondation
   C. le vent
   D. l'orage

18. How do you say 'It is hot.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il pleut.
   B. Il fait froid.
   C. Il fait beau.
   D. Il fait chaud.

19. How do you say 'the garden' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le magasin
   B. le jardin
   C. le tapis
   D. la clé

20. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'key'? (1 mark)
   A. cé
   B. cle
   C. clè
   D. clé

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into French: 'The ball is behind the door.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Translate into French: 'It is sunny.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Write three instructions in French to tell a friend where to put things in a room. (5 marks) (5 marks)

24. Translate into French: 'The TV is on the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Translate into French: 'They are mangoes.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Translate into French: 'She is short.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

27. Translate into French: 'I have a mouth.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

28. Translate into French: 'I am ten years old.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

29. Translate into French: 'It is a banana.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

30. Translate into French: 'What day is it today?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

31. Translate into French: 'He is tall.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Enchanté
   The correct spelling is Enchanté, with its accents.

2. D — Madame
   Mrs, Madam in French is Madame.

3. A — grand-mère
   The correct spelling is grand-mère, with its accents.

4. D — grand-père
   The correct spelling is grand-père, with its accents.

5. B — le sac
   the bag in French is le sac.

6. B — le lit
   the bed in French is le lit.

7. D — Le sac est sous la chaise.
   The order is the thing, est, the position word, the place.

8. B — mercredi
   Wednesday in French is mercredi.

9. A — école
   The correct spelling is école, with its accents.

10. D — une fête
   a party in French is une fête.

11. D — juillet
   July in French is juillet.

12. A — le gâteau
   the cake in French is le gâteau.

13. B — le riz
   rice in French is le riz.

14. A — l'orange
   the orange in French is l'orange.

15. A — tête
   The correct spelling is tête, with its accents.

16. D — l'oreille
   the ear in French is l'oreille.

17. B — une inondation
   a flood in French is une inondation.

18. D — Il fait chaud.
   It is hot. in French is Il fait chaud..

19. B — le jardin
   the garden in French is le jardin.

20. D — clé
   The correct spelling is clé, with its accents.
